input: Each Q/W/E/R/T key is held at zero-based frames 20 through 39, then released; unmodified emulator stepFrame timing.
placement: Source actor X is the bitmap's left edge; actor Y is the bitmap's last/bottom row. Decode record bitmap rows in reverse order for screen-downward presentation.
comparison: For every sprite rectangle, compare the projected 1-bit mask against the source screen's rendered bright-or-normal white pixels; includes both set and unset mask pixels.
limits: The 124 white/off mismatches occur in 11 W frames (43–53): 48 also differ in the bitmap bit and 76 have the expected bitmap bit but not the expected white color. There are 16 additional bitmap-bit differences whose white/off color still agrees (64 bitmap-bit differences total). An externally selected two-mask XOR projection matches all 3776 source bitmap pixels in those 11 player rectangles, including all 64 bit changes. All 124 white/off mismatches fall in 8x8 attribute cells occupied by the other actor's bitmap. This is one measured pair and timing path, not a general source draw order, actor scheduler or color/attribute rule. The remaining 76 white/off-only mismatches still need attribute/write tracing; the result does not establish general layering or combat.
